(4) Rewrote utils/generate_subtitles.py: removed every numpy/sys.modules/strict=False shim, dropped the RMS silence loop entirely, now extracts a 16kHz mono WAV via ffmpeg and segments on word gaps. Added --min-silence/--min-segment. (5) Start-SubtitleGeneration.ps1 now uses vw-cli's own utils/.venv, no longer vault-streaming's. (6) Added utils/requirements.txt pinning nemo_toolkit[asr]==2.5.0 with a comment explaining why Nemotron must not be swapped back in.
